## Notes

Maxis, EA; Windows 2003-01-14, Mac OS X 2003-06-27; Rush Hour expansion 2003-09-22; regions of cities 1-4 km per side with neighbor deals for water, power, and garbage; God, Mayor, and MySim modes; zone densities, agriculture zone, wealth levels, decay and gentrification; per-building service funding, aging facilities; Rush Hour traffic tracing; Jeff Speck on the traffic model; Building Architect Tool (2004).
